status: reused synthetic development diagnostic, not independent confirmation
forecast_target: P(terminal episode risk label = 1 | observed event prefix); neither risk already realized nor a fixed-time horizon
prefix_sampling: all nonempty observed-event prefixes, including terminal; weight 1 / episode length so each fit episode has total weight 1
terminal_bn_target: terminal episode label from terminal evidence only; its earlier scores are an out-of-training-scope comparison

alarm_threshold.selection: lowest threshold satisfying the empirical constraint using only validation-negative episode maximum scores; comparison is >= with nextafter tie handling
alarm_threshold.guarantee: empirical validation constraint only; not population FPR control or a safety guarantee

warning_reference: strictly before first observed tool_call; also report privileged-tool dispatch separately; neither is an independent harm timestamp
feature_contract: same 49-dimensional evidence for all models; runtime_only ignores edge_kind; missing permission is masked for every method
architecture_limit: before tool_proposed/tool_call only global_context is active; this experiment does not implement the complete two-layer architecture
